name: clean-01-magic-numbers
description: quality-perception: magic numbers and unclear names
prompt: Read Review.cpp and identify the readability problems. Name each magic value and what should replace it.

fake_replies.content: The magic values should become named constants: 1000 is the tax threshold, 0.2 and 0.1 are the two tax rates, and 5000 is the timeout. Give each a descriptive constant name so the intent is visible.
